response.original_title: Official FAQS-How do I add a passenger to my Royal Caribbean Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise booking, +1-866-829-1280 or +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) you must call Royal Caribbean Customer Service directly or contact your travel advisor, +1-866-829-1280 or +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) as this cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. Once confirmed, you must pay the additional Cruise fare, taxes, and port charges for the new guest. Yes, you can add a person to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise by calling Customer Support directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) or reaching out to your travel agent.
